design.summary: Heavy gold and blue plate knight with a huge kite shield on the left arm and a big warhammer in the right hand.
design.silhouette: Broad rounded helm with a small crest, huge shield covering the left half of the body, hammer head bulging over the right shoulder; very wide and short.

headgear.description: Rounded gold-trimmed steel great helm with a T-shaped visor slit and a short blue plume crest.

armour.description: Large rounded gold pauldrons with blue rivets.
Silver breastplate with a gold sun emblem over a blue tabard.
Gold-buckled brown belt holding a blue tabard skirt.
Huge blue kite shield with a gold rim and a gold sun boss, strapped to the left arm.
Heavy silver greaves and boots with gold knee caps.

design.cloth: Short blue tabard with gold trim front and back; a white-and-blue cape fixed at the shoulders hanging to the knees.
design.weapon_summary: Big two-faced steel warhammer with a short brown handle and a gold band, held in the right hand; large kite shield on the left arm.

proportions.style: short wide chibi: big head (about 1/3 of the height), stocky wide torso, short thick limbs, big hands and boots
proportions.notes: Standing height is equal in the down, up and right views. Feet of every frame rest on ONE baseline row.

weapon.name: warhammer
weapon.description: Big two-faced steel warhammer with a short brown handle and a gold band, held in the right hand; large kite shield on the left arm.

down.descriptor: FRONT view (down): the figure faces the camera, face and chest visible, both boots visible, toes toward the viewer.

up.descriptor: BACK view (up): the figure faces away from the camera. NO face, NO eyes, NO mouth anywhere: show only the back of the head/headgear, the back of the torso, back armour and the cape/cloth hanging down the back, and the heels of both boots. Back view: crest and helm back, the cape falling from the shoulders with a gold sun emblem, shield strapped on the left back arm, hammer handle over the right shoulder.

right.descriptor: RIGHT side view (right): a TRUE side profile facing the right edge of the image, body turned exactly 90 degrees, one eye only, nose/brow in profile; the NEAR arm and NEAR leg are drawn IN FRONT of the torso, the far limbs partly hidden behind it.

poses: Stand relaxed, feet shoulder-width apart, the warhammer resting on the right shoulder or held low, shield on the left arm, chest rests low.
Breathe in: torso rises one pixel step, shoulders lift slightly, the tabard and cape.
Peak of the breath: head and chest at their highest, arms swing a hair outward, the tabard and cape sways a little.
Breathe out: torso sinks back lower than frame 1, weight shifts slightly, the tabard and cape settles.
Contact: left boot planted forward, right boot behind on its toes, arms opposite to legs, the warhammer resting on the right shoulder or held low, shield on the left arm.
Down: body at its lowest, left boot flat under the body, right boot lifting off, right knee bent.
Passing: right leg swings through beside the planted left leg, body at its highest, the tabard and cape.
Contact: right boot planted forward, left boot behind on its toes, arms swapped, the warhammer resting on the right shoulder or held low, shield on the left arm.
Down: body at its lowest, right boot flat under the body, left boot lifting off, left knee bent.
Passing: left leg swings through beside the planted right leg, body at its highest, the tabard and cape flares.
Wind-up: hammer raised high overhead in the right hand, shield forward to guard, knees bent.
Hammer comes down in a heavy overhead arc, shield arm steadying the body, front foot stepping.
Impact: hammer head slammed down at the far reach in front of the feet, torso bent forward behind the shield.
Follow-through: hammer low and forward at the end of the extended arm, weight on the front foot.
Recover: hammer lifted back to the shoulder, shield raised, feet together.
Gather: hammer raised in the right hand straight up, shield held in front of the chest, head bowed.
Hammer glows gold, held overhead, shield arm lifts up beside it, knees bending.
Arms spread, hammer high at the right and shield high at the left, chest out, tabard flaring.
Thrust: hammer pointed straight forward at shoulder height, far ahead of the body, shield pulled back.
Recover: hammer lowering to the carry pose, shield dropping, cape settling.
Crouch low, knees bent deeply, head ducked forward, the warhammer resting on the right shoulder or held low, shield on the left arm pulled in tight.
Launch: body tipping forward, head tucked, back arching, both boots still visible leaving the floor.
Tumble 1: figure curled into a compact ball, head near the knees, back toward the camera side, boots tucked.
Tumble 2: the ball has rotated half a turn, upside down, boots up top, head tucked below.
Tumble 3: rotating up out of the ball, legs reaching down toward the ground, head coming up.
Landing: one knee bent, other boot planted, rising out of the roll, the warhammer resting on the right shoulder or held low, shield on the left arm back in hand.
Struck: head snaps back, torso leans away from the blow, eyes squeezed shut, arms flung outward, the warhammer resting on the right shoulder or held low, shield on the left arm.
Recoil: body bent at the waist, knees buckled, one boot sliding back, wincing, the warhammer resting on the right shoulder or held low, shield on the left arm.
Fatal hit: head snaps back, torso arching, the warhammer resting on the right shoulder or held low, shield on the left arm loosening in the grip.
Stumble: knees give way, one knee drops, a hand drops the weapon, head hangs.
Fall: body topples sideways, both arms flailing, boots leaving the ground.
Impact: the body lands on its side, weapon clattering beside it, cloth settling.
Slump: the body flat on the ground, one arm stretched out, legs straight, head turned.
Final: lying completely still on the ground, weapon at rest next to the hand, cloth lying flat. Feet on the baseline row.
